audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer calls this a 'Favoured matchup' at 4/10 while diff is HARD and the Emerald+ win rate is 47.33%.
audit.why: A sub-50% win rate with an immobile-but-oppressive ranged juggernaut is not a favoured lane; the page contradicts itself.
audit.corrected: Losing matchup wording, Urgot carry threat raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Lillia wins Level 1 and 2+ items, and 'Skill' for Levels 2-5, contradicting the content-layer whys and the packet chart.
audit.why: whys[0] states Urgot walks up and chunks her at 1; whys[6] states Urgot reclaims it late; whys[1-3] state 2-5 are Lillia's peak. Packet levelChart reads Urgot, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Skill, Skill, Urgot.
audit.corrected: Rows 0/1/2/3/6 flipped in both layers with matching ratings, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Never named Urgot's abilities and never stated the decisive interaction: Disdain tramples non-champion units, so standing behind the minion wave does not stop the flip.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.' Disdain cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, range 475. Purge (W) slows Urgot himself and is free at rank 5 (cd 12/9/6/3/0, cost 40/30/20/10/0). Corrosive Charge (Q) is 800 range vs Lillia's 700 E and 450 Q, so he outranges her poke. Fear Beyond Death is a 100/85/70s projectile execute on the first champion hit.
audit.corrected: Real names used; the minion-trample fact, the 14-16s Disdain window, and the self-slow on Purge now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'take the fifteen-second invitation' was an invented cooldown number.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, not a flat fifteen.
